message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Check
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]
    branches:
      - "**"
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
env:
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=10240
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup node@26
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 26
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@73e46992e05b19abd31f2f3c20e0e7370d762115 # v6.1.1
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Check formatting
        run: node --run format:check
      - name: Build packages
        run: node --run build
      - name: Lint
        run: node --run lint
      - name: Verify rules
        run: node --run check:rules
      - name: Lint MDX
        run: node --run lint:mdx
      - name: Check website types
        run: pnpm -F "./apps/website" run types:check",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured experiment evidence showing 26.83% elapsed savings with no loss of success (3/3 before and after). The repository has representative successful-duration history (~2-3 minutes across 5 recent runs), satisfying the pattern precondition. The workflow currently lacks a job timeout, so adding timeout-minutes: 5 bounds runaway consumption while preserving every build, test, lint, and typecheck step and all required coverage. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
